changes: Persons, roles, date and place are unchanged.

Expanded the notes: the catalogue gives the scribe as 'Śrīrāma Upādhyāya', but the colophon reads 'rāma upādhyāyena', so the 'Śrī' is probably honorific; 'liṣitaṃ' is the usual ṣ-for-kh spelling of likhitaṃ.

notes: 'liṣitaṃ' = likhitaṃ (ṣ for kh). The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Śrīrāma Upādhyāya'. The colophon reads only 'rāma upādhyāyena', so the 'Śrī' is probably honorific. 'likhitaṃ kavala(!)' is unclear. It is probably a mistake for 'kevalam' or a fragment of a set scribal phrase, not a personal name. The colophon has no date or place. This colophon closes the Uttarakāṇḍa (fol. 193). The reel also contains the Āraṇya- and Kiṣkindhākāṇḍas, which may have colophons of their own that are not quoted here.
